name: Project Ignition
detailed_description:
Project Ignition is a fast-paced 3v3 vehicular combat game where two teams fight to push their Crawlers—massive team-controlled vehicles—across the battlefield to a central finish line. The first team to get their Crawler to the end wins, but victory takes more than just firepower.

Each match centers around fuel control. Nitro canisters spawn at key points on the map, creating hotspots for high-stakes skirmishes. Secure the canister, survive the clash, and deliver it to your Crawler to give it a temporary speed boost. The more fuel you run, the faster your team’s Crawler advances.

Matches are designed to keep the pressure high and momentum shifting. Whether you're leading or catching up, every play has the potential to swing the outcome in your favor.

Pick from a lineup of distinct vehicles, each equipped with unique weapons and abilities suited to different roles and playstyles. Whether you're flanking, defending, or leading the charge, smart coordination and timing are the keys to victory.

Drive hard, play smart, and fight for every inch. In Ignition, the team that works together moves faster.

Command uniquely armed vehicles, unleash powerful abilities, and outmaneuver your rivals in a race that only gets faster—and deadlier—the closer you get to victory.
